items.title: Events
items.description: - Events now contain an `entity` root field that contains information about the entity or entities related to an event. These can be used in Event Rules and other components of Reflex to perform additional automation and investigation steps.

items.title: Detections
items.description:
- Detection Repository subscriptions now support copying the repositories tags to all detection rules synchronized from said repository.  This is enabled by default and is controlled on a per subscription basis.
- When viewing the details of a Detection from the Event Drawer, the Email Template and Description will now have any mustache variables replaced correctly.

items.title: User Management
items.description:
- Corrected an issue where new users are not assigned their Roles correctly.
- Corrected an issue where a new user may have some information cloned from another user if the last action on User Management was to edit a user without roles without saving the user.
